items.text: J.P. Morgan Called a Potential Elon Musk SpaceX-Tesla Merger "Strategically Coherent"
items.summary_cn: JPMorgan认为SpaceX与Tesla潜在合并具有'战略一致性'，直接利好kcn持有的SpaceX相关标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's xAI is now officially called SpaceXAI
items.summary_cn: Musk宣布xAI正式更名为SpaceXAI，xAI与SpaceX进一步整合，利好持有的SpaceX相关标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s Net Worth Drops Below $900 Billion With SpaceX Nearing IPO Value
items.summary_cn: Musk净资产跌破9000亿美元，SpaceX接近IPO估值，对持有的SpaceX杠杆/正股ETF是直接定价信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk and Sam Altman accuse each other of scamming investors as each pitches their AI vision
items.summary_cn: Musk与Sam Altman互相指控对方在AI愿景上欺骗投资者，AI行业叙事冲突升级。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk quietly buys a $1 billion gas turbine company to power Grok
items.summary_cn: Musk悄悄以10亿美元收购一家燃气轮机公司为Grok供电，AI算力电力供应主题。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Pollution from Musk’s unpermitted xAI power project hits hardest in Black communities
items.summary_cn: Musk未获许可的xAI发电项目污染对黑人社区影响最大，可能引发监管/舆论风险。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Labor Department reports annual inflation in June was 3.5%, biggest monthly drop in over six years: https://justthenews.com/nation/economy/labor-department-reports-annual-inflation-june-was-35-biggest-monthly-drop-over-six
items.summary_cn: 美国6月年化通胀3.5%，月度降幅创六年新高，宏观面影响利率预期与风险资产。

items.summary_cn: Trump称霍尔木兹海峡已对所有国家开放（伊朗除外），并对伊朗实施全面封锁，暗示油价供应受军事支撑，能源/宏观面利好。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump touts U.S. economy and oil prices in a midterm pitch in Pennsylvania: https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-touts-us-economy-oil-prices-midterm-pitch-pennsylvania-rcna351414
items.summary_cn: Trump在宾州中期选举造势中吹捧美国经济和油价，宏观信心表态。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump claims military victory, points to economic progress in the wake of first-stage Iran deal: https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/jun/23/trump-claims-military-victory-points-economic-progress-wake-first/
items.summary_cn: Trump在伊朗一阶段协议后宣称军事胜利并强调经济进展，宏观面利好叙事。

items.text: Elon Musk's Tesla Posts Best Quarter in Two Years
